course.title: Physics 709 — Introduction to Quantum Computing
course.subtitle: From one qubit to algorithms, error correction and hardware, built from the ground up

lectures.title: Lecture 2 (9/9): representations, bases, change of basis, polarization, operators
Lecture 3 (9/14): measurement, projectors, Bloch parametrization and Bloch vector, Hermitian operators
Lecture 4 (9/16): eigenproblem, functions of operators, commutators, uncertainty
Lecture 5 (9/21): multiparticle systems, tensor product, gates, Bell basis, Bell measurement
Lecture 6 (9/23): commuting stabilizers, GHZ, X and Y bases, bit-string parities
Lecture 7 (9/28): GHZ observables, Mermin, why the density matrix
Lecture 8 (9/30): working with the density matrix, mixed states, decompositions, bipartite density matrix
Lecture 10 (10/7): entanglement, convexity, coherence criterion, concurrence, partial transpose, entropies, two-spin correlations
Lecture 11 (10/12): Bell’s inequality and the CHSH form
